notes: HOLE is the official four-hole pattern (the Uno's holes are not on a regular grid; absolute coordinates from the datasheet drawing). The USB-B and DC jack axes are both along -X on the same short edge, 30.5 mm apart (assumed centres 38.1 and 7.6), so their plug overmolds (plug_usb_b 16 x 13, plug_dc_barrel_5p5 about 11 mm handle) must both fit in that spacing: the sweep envelopes are checked by the assembly checks. MCU is a point datum for the ventilation row over the ATmega328P (a 28-pin DIP in a socket, 4.6 mm tall body, about 35 x 7.6 mm); its position is an estimate (+/-8 mm), so the slot row should span at least 40 mm along the board's long axis or be aligned in the iteration after measuring the owner's board. Generalize delta 003 D1: the `mcu` zone interface names the footprint (mcu_length x mcu_width round MCU, long along X) so a vent row 'over the ATmega328P' can be placed by rule. Header keepout: female headers (8.5 mm) run along both long edges. Import gate: R1 matches the PCB 68.6 x 53.3; R2 hole pattern from the drawing; R4 overhangs are assumed (tol 1.5); R9 skipped.
